#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

class Point {
public:
    long long a, b, c, d, e;
    
    Point(long long a, long long b, long long c, long long d, long long e)
        : a(a), b(b), c(c), d(d), e(e) {}
    
    Point minus(const Point& rhs) const {
        return Point(a - rhs.a, b - rhs.b, c - rhs.c, d - rhs.d, e - rhs.e);
    }
    
    bool dot(const Point& rhs) const {
        return a * rhs.a + b * rhs.b + c * rhs.c + d * rhs.d + e * rhs.e > 0;
    }
};

void solve() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 40) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return;
    }
    
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        long long a, b, c, d, e;
        cin >> a >> b >> c >> d >> e;
        points.push_back(Point(a, b, c, d, e));
    }
    
    if (n < 3) {
        cout << n << endl;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            cout << i << endl;
        }
        return;
    }
    
    vector<int> result;
    for (int center = 0; center < n; ++center) {
        bool find = false;
        for (int a = 0; a < n && !find; ++a) {
            if (a != center) {
                for (int b = 0; b < n && !find; ++b) {
                    if (b != center && b != a) {
                        Point A = points[a].minus(points[center]);
                        Point B = points[b].minus(points[center]);
                        if (A.dot(B)) {
                            find = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (!find) result.push_back(center + 1);
    }
    
    cout << result.size() << endl;
    for (int id : result) {
        cout << id << endl;
    }
}

int main() {
    solve();
    return 0;
}
